notes.title: LEENIE'S TALE Demo Update – New Mode & Features!
notes.notes:
[i][h2]Hey everyone![/h2][/i]
I'm excited to present the updated demo version of LEENIE'S TALE! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088603/ee343e2a9d6edfc8b9eec3c9ad3c17e330694b09.png[/img]
I've put a lot of work into expanding the demo, adding new mechanics and content. I hope you'll enjoy it!

[i][h2]What's new?[/h2][/i]

[b]New game mode[/b] – now you must find 5 keys while the fox hunts you! 🦊
[b]In-game achievements [/b]– compete with your friends (or with me 😆). I might even share my own results in Discord!
[b]Enhanced atmosphere & improved balance[/b] – the game is now more intense, and the difficulties are better tuned.

[i][h2]Challenge yourself![/h2][/i]
Think you can handle hard mode? Try it… if you dare! 😈😈😈

[i][h2]Share your feedback![/h2][/i]
I’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions, they’ll help make the game even better! ❤️

So download, play, and have fun! 
[h1][i]Enjoy the game! ^^[/i][/h1]

notes.title: Get Ready for the Chase – Boog Awaits!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I've got some bombastic news – the page for my new game is now live on Steam! 🎉 I'm here, like a lone wolf, crafting this project and really hope you'll like it. So hurry up, follow the link, add the game to your wishlist, and get ready for some wild chases from the terrifying fox! 🦊💨

Your wishlist adds are like a power-up for me to finish the game faster. Thanks for all your support and those warm comments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051030/LEENIES_TALE/

I can't wait to hear what you think about it! 😄

notes.title: New languages!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
I would like to wish you a happy New year! I hope you met him cheerfully :)
In this update, two new languages will be added - Turkish and Polish.

notes.title: Thanks everyone for your support!
notes.notes:
I want to thank everyone who tried our demo version and appreciated it. The development is in full swing, and I do not plan to stop there. Thanks to you, I realized in what direction it is necessary to change the game and what needs to be added in the future. 

Thank you very much again!
